item.title: 3 men charged after Shockoe Bottom shooting killed 2, injured 7
item.description: Richmond authorities are providing more updates after two people were arrested Saturday in connection with a deadly Shockoe Bottom shooting last month.

item.title: Dead fish blanket parts of Virginia Beach shoreline
item.description: Dead fish have washed up along the beaches of Sandbridge. Friday morning, WAVY found fish blanketing the shoreline under a heavy layer of fog.

item.title: 'Fantastic Shape': New 3D Images reveal secrets of USS Monitor shipwreck
item.description: For the first time since it sank more than 160 years ago, the public is getting a high-definition look at the Civil War’s most famous ironclad.

item.title: Norfolk police investigate early morning shooting on Mariners Way
item.description: A woman was found suffering from a gunshot wound at a home in the 500 block of Mariners Way early Sunday morning and was transported to the hospital with non-life-threatening injuries.

item.title: Man sentenced to eight years for deadly shooting at Norfolk Cook Out
item.description: NORFOLK, Va. (WAVY) — A man was sentenced to eight years in prison for a June 2024 fatal shooting at a Norfolk Cook Out drive-thru. item.title: 'We honor his service and sacrifice': Soldier with Virginia ties killed during operation in Kuwait
item.description: A man with ties to Spotsylvania County was killed after an Iranian strike in Kuwait, according to Gov. Abigail Spanberger (D) and U.S. Senators Mark Warner and Tim Kaine (Both D-Va.).

item.title: Virginia Beach residents report body found in water near Foxwood Drive and Federal Court
item.description: Residents in a Virginia Beach neighborhood reported a body found in the pond off Foxwood Drive and Federal Court Saturday afternoon.

item.title: Norfolk police investigating fatal motorcycle crash on Terminal Boulevard
item.description: A 24-year-old motorcyclist was killed in a two-vehicle crash at the intersection of Terminal Boulevard and Ruthven Road late Saturday night, and the driver of the sedan was uninjured.

item.title: VBPD: Shooting on Atlantic Avenue leaves five injured
item.description: Five individuals were struck by gunfire in a shooting incident in the 1800 block of Atlantic Avenue in Virginia Beach, and police are searching for two suspects who fled the scene.
